seedVariables.ciSetupSteps:
- name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install
seedVariables.moduleStructure:
api/
bin/
cmd/
internal/
packaging/
scripts/
web/
seedVariables.stackSection:
- **Language:** typescript
- **Package manager:** npm
- **Test framework:** jest
- **Framework:** express
seedVariables.verificationCmd: if [ -f package.json ]; then npm install --include=dev && if [ -f tsconfig.json ]; then npx tsc --noEmit; fi && npx jest --passWithNoTests; else echo "no package.json yet - skipping verification"; fi
